text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Nakayama Festa's interview 
remarks, lingering resentment swirled 
within Tosen Jordan. She had lost her 
goals and hope to injury. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find myself heading to the Japanese 
Derby venue. ...If someone can show me a 
dream, I want them to show it to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Nakayama Festa talks to her 
Trainer about the Yushun Himba (Japanese 
Oaks) winner. The public seems to have 
high hopes for her taking on overseas 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A hope that differs from one's own. A 
rushing torrent of an era bearing down. 
The die has already been cast. —The 
Japanese Derby begins.
